capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia Q8 table: 2019 e-tron 55 95 kWh gross; InsideEVs 2018 launch material 95 kWh pack; Weekly Driver 95 total for 2019-2023.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver names this exact car (Audi e-tron and Sportback 2019-2023, 95 kWh): "NCM 622", LG Chem/LGES pouch cells; InsideEVs confirms LG Chem pouch cells but not the chemistry. Third-party, not an Audi statement; NCM 622 maps to the nmc enum.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Wikipedia table: 2019 e-tron 55 usable 83.6 kWh as built, raised to 86.5 kWh by an Oct 2021 software update (reported for Europe; North American roll-out not confirmed). Model years compared: 2019-2023.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: InsideEVs (2018 e-tron launch material): "The nominal voltage of the system is 396 V." 2019-2023 compared, pack unchanged.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs (Audi 2018 launch material): fast charging at 150 kW (0-80 % in 30 min); Wikipedia Q8 table also 150 kW. Some sources say 155 kW peak.

ac_max_kw.notes: US: "a 40A 9.6 kW J1772 charger is supplied by Audi" (Wikipedia). Europe is 11 kW (Audi). Canada not separately sourced; same equipment assumed. Model years compared: 2019-2023 (no change shown).
